name: New Logo
notes:
Summary  
Nominal seeks a refreshed logo for use across print and digital channels, aimed at enterprise and midsize brands led by CFOs, Controllers, and Accountants. The design must modernize the current identity without echoing competitor marks.

Task Description  
• Task Name: New Logo  
• Format: Digital (print-ready files also required)  
• Animation: Not required  
• Purpose: Redesign Nominal’s logo to strengthen brand recognition and appeal to financial decision-makers  
• Display Locations: All brand touchpoints (website, presentations, stationery, marketing collateral)  
• Target Audience: CFOs, Controllers, Accountants at enterprise and midsize organizations  
• Dimensions/Technical Specifications: Standard logo formats; deliver vector files (AI/EPS/PDF) plus high-resolution PNG and JPG in color and monochrome  
• Budget: (not specified; hours to be confirmed)  
• Things to Avoid: Any resemblance to competitor logos or color schemes  
• Notes: NA  
• Due Date: 2025-08-31  
• Pre-kickoff Meeting: Not required  

When asked about the values and messaging of the logo. here is what Stephanie said
    Trustworthy -- our customers trust that the data in Nominal is accurate and reliable. 
    Tech-forward, Modern -- Nominal is an AI first software. For our competitors, AI is an afterthought. Also Nominal uses AI Agents to help businesses get more done. 
    Forward Momentum - Our customers want to move quickly and sale their business. Our product allows them to do that without hiring more people.
when asked how she would describe Nominal in 4-5 words: "ERP agnostic. Easy to implement."
